summary: [spec fidelity] the validators that clap's value parser enforces (the calendar of the 12 time options, `--introduced-rev self`, `--surface-ref`) answer before the declared constraints, so the one order the CHANGELOG states (required, domains, constraints in the document's order, validators) does not hold for them: `divergence add --state deferred --expiry 2026-02-30` (no --reason) is USAGE at --expiry, not DIVERGENCE_INVALID_ARGUMENT at --reason; `purge --before 2026-02-30 --commit` is USAGE at --before, not the requires of --plan-digest; `finding add --introduced-rev self --introduced-unknown` is USAGE at --introduced-rev, not the atMostOne; also a bad value of a parser-coded domain answers before a missing required argument (`finding close Bad_Id --round 1` is CHANGE_ID); 10.8.3 puts validators after domains and constraints, the required-versus-domain order is not fixed by the spec; exit 2 and nothing written either way, only the code and field of a multi-fault call differ; blast radius: the 12 time options, --introduced-rev, --surface-ref (evidence add, approval-payload)
